measured.sample: 637 tracked *.hs files (all 637 files >= 1KB from cabal@670955a4 — cabal: the Haskell build tool itself, the language-representative corpus)
measured.note: Analyzer rewritten pure-AST for M12.25 to the FP-family contract (Clojure/Elixir/Erlang precedent): 9 census regexes eliminated (78 -> 69) — data-constructor name via prefix/record constructor nodes (was /^[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*/ text match), import alias/paren strips via pure char scans, HOF detection via paren/arrow char scan (was regex on the type signature), instance target-type via type_patterns->parens->apply AST descent (was text split). The post-loop identifier call-graph walker was REMOVED entirely (it flooded hundreds of edges: 'calls Global -> a', 'calls classify -> n == 0', operators as calls) — calls now come from a single-pass apply-head extraction. Defects fixed: module contains edges (the module scope popped when the header subtree ended, so no ownerName on module-level symbols — now tracked via ctx.currentModule and post-loop contains); imports now source the MODULE (was self-source: references Data.List -> Data.List); deriving (Show, Eq) implements edges fire (names nested in deriving->tuple); class superclass extends edges fire (context->apply first child); instance class/target parsed pure-AST (was regex text split); where/let-local functions are no longer symbols (Namespace scopes restored) and their bodies attribute nothing to the enclosing function; do-notation binds (z <- fetch x) are expression-level (never symbols) but their applies execute in the enclosing function; operator/infix nodes mark patterns only (Monads/Functors) — never call edges; type variables, Prelude/imported functions, and record-field selectors produce no call edges (FP-family resolution: unqualified calls emit only when the target is a module-level declared function; self-recursion and mutual recursion ARE emitted); pattern-position constructor applications are never instantiates (body-position ctor-app emits instantiates, Erlang record_expr analog); contains self-loops skipped (data User = User {...} would collapse into a self-loop). All symbol lookups O(1) via functionSymbolIndex (the per-signature .find() scan eliminated). Differential 75/75 (1.000/1.000, 0 FP / 0 FN). Corpus: 7/637 grammar-error files (1.1%), 0 crashes — all classified: 3 template files with {{placeholder}} syntax (not real Haskell), 2 TemplateHaskell quasiquote files ([d| ... |] brackets unparseable without TH), 1 CRLF multi-line string continuation, 1 GADTs pattern file; recorded honestly as grammar limitations. Grammar: npm tree-sitter-haskell 0.23.1 behaviorally identical (7 vs 7 error files, 0 fixed, 0 regressed) — no upgrade warranted. Shape-safe: 34/35 analyzer node refs live in the pinned grammar's actual emitted types (193 distinct from 2,151 corpus files); the 1 remaining (MISSING) is the defensive tree-sitter error-path check. Complexity: 17,828 symbols / 34,755 relationships in 16.0s on the 637-file corpus; all single-pass, zero O(n^2) (loop-structure scan + no .find/.filter/.some over symbols).

measured.sample: 243 tracked *.py files (all 243 files >= 1KB from cython@51a460b7 — cython: the Cython compiler (a real production Python codebase), the language-representative corpus)
measured.note: Analyzer rewritten pure-AST for M12.27 to the scripting-family contract (JS/TS precedent): all 5 census regexes eliminated (69 -> 64) — module-name extension strip via pure char scan (was /\.[^.]*$/), decorator @strip and quote strips replaced by AST token reads. Scope-restore leak fixed (exit frames now ALWAYS assign currentClass/currentFunction, may restore to undefined — the old guard skipped undefined so currentFunction never reset, leaking decorator calls like calls save -> dataclass to the wrong source). Decorator calls are metadata, never calls. Nested functions (wrapper inside logged) and function locals (store, service) are NOT symbols and never change the call source (LocalsAreNotSymbols / ParamsAreNotSymbols, JS M12.09 contract). Enum members emitted once as enum_member (was duplicated as property); instantiates only for in-file declared classes/enums via an O(1) declaredTypes set (imported classes like TypeVar never instantiate); async detection fixed to the grammar's real shape (function_definition with anonymous async token — the old async_function_definition ref was dead); dictionary_comprehension (not dict_comprehension); first (leftmost) base wins for overrides (Python MRO — was picking Repository over BaseService). Calls emit LEAF targets with a Python builtin filter + dunder filter; module-level symbols ownerless (Python has no module declaration); extends from the base-class argument list; imports as `imports module -> path:item`; exports from __all__. Grammar UPGRADED to npm tree-sitter-python 0.25.0 (was a stale pre-0.25.0 pin): the corrected wasm comparison (fresh subprocess per scan — the old in-process swap was silently invalid because _autoLoadWasm caches registry bytes at module init, so both scans read the pinned grammar) shows 9 -> 7 error files (fixes test_tstring.py + test_templatelib.py, Cython fused-type template-string prefixes, 0 regressions), and recovers the correct overrides edge on generic-subscript bases (UserService.__init__ -> BaseService.__init__ with Repository[User] — the pinned grammar never parsed the subscripted base list, so the override was silently missing; the M12 GT override fact only fired on plain bases). Shape-safe 51/51 refs live (4 anonymous keyword tokens and/async/import/or confirmed via anonymous-child scan). The 7 remaining grammarErrorFiles are all Cython-specific extensions, not real Python: memoryview slice annotations (bm_matrix.py, compute_fused_types.py, compute_prange.py, memoryview_annotation_typing.py, pure_warnings.py `Bar[:, :, :]`), Cython type syntax (e_typing_optional.py `Optional[cython.int]` / `double[:]`), pattern-matching edge cases (test_patma.py) — recorded honestly. Complexity: 15,558 symbols / 30,901 relationships in 23s on the 243-file corpus; zero O(n^2) (the per-uppercase-call symbols.some() instantiates scan replaced with the O(1) declaredTypes set). Differential 90/90 (1.000/1.000, 0 FP / 0 FN) on first run.
